cas_default.description: College of Arts & Sciences Double Dipping Policy

notes: GLST is the binding constraint. PLSC uses CAS default (21 unique).
The 3-from-single-dept cap applies to GLST ELECTIVES only, not required core courses.
PLSC 102 is a required GLST core course and does NOT count against the 3-PLSC-elective cap.
A PLSC course used as a GLST elective only burns an overlap slot if it ALSO counts toward the PLSC major.
A PLSC elective in GLST that is NOT fulfilling a PLSC major requirement = no overlap consumed.
